headline: A Georgia Cop Used Flock to Track 2 Other Cops: His Ex and Her Friend
context: After an affair with a fellow police officer ended, a Georgia cop used Flock to track her movements—and those of a man whose vehicle often showed up near hers, internal investigation records show.
